notes.title: The Light Charmers is now available for free trial!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone![/p][p]We are Liquid Meow Games, an independent game development studio! Our team, Light Charmers, has just launched a DEMO version of our game, [b]The Light Charmers[/b], on STEAM. We are a student team from Hangzhou, and this is our very first game.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3707050/_/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3707100/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]The Light Charmers[/b] is an innovative dark hand-drawn style tower defense rogue-like game, where both the towers and your mouse can attack enemies. We welcome everyone to give it a try and share your valuable feedback with us! If you like it, please consider adding it to your wishlist![/p][p]If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to fill out our online questionnaire: [url="https://m01nl7uomo.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnRfepSBnyEFR3incFb6OLwd" style="button"]Link to the questionnaire[/url][/p][p]Let us know about any bugs or suggestions you have.[/p][p][/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]Liquid Meow Games & The Light Charmers Development Team[/p]
